supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The supraorbital ridge extends horizontally past the lateral orbital margins, creating a broad 2D width.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; the muzzle area contains significantly higher pixel intensity values compared to the dark, low-intensity cheek and periocular regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high-contrast, linear band of depigmented skin across the supraorbital ridge.
